:::{#def-precision-matrix}

#### Precision matrix

The **precision matrix** of a $p \times 1$ [random](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) vector $\vX$ whose [variance matrix](#def-cov-vec-x) is
[positive definite](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-special-matrices.html#def-positive-definite)
is the [matrix inverse](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-special-matrices.html#def-matrix-inverse) of that variance matrix:

$$\precision(\vX) \eqdef \inv{\Varf{\vX}}.$$

:::
